name: Slake That Thirst

meta.next: Another Power Source?, Tanaris Field Sampling

summary: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan can supply the 4711-FTZ power source for your kit, but first wants something to drink: five Wastewander Water Pouches, to be had from the Wastewander nomads east of town.

sections.title: A Drink for a Power Source
sections.body: After Into the Field, you know the kit needs a power source, and Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan can help. The price is a drink: five Wastewander Water Pouches. Bilgewhizzle points you to the Wastewander nomads east of Gadgetzan, suggests you simply walk up to one and ask, and wants to hear how that works out.

sections.title: A Limit on the Power
sections.body: Once the pouches are handed over, the power source is yours, but it was not made for a science kit. There is only so long before every bit of data you gather is lost: two hours at most. When you have what you need, bring it back to Bilgewhizzle to be shut down properly. If time runs out, another power source can be had, but it will be sold, not given.

faq.q: Who asks for the water pouches?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan, who wants five of them in return for the 4711-FTZ power source.

faq.q: Where do you find the Wastewander Water Pouches?
faq.answer: From the Wastewander nomads, who are found to the east of Gadgetzan.

faq.q: What power source does Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle offer?
faq.answer: The 4711-FTZ, the power source for your kit.
